name: Mediate
def: Taking damage with [Rage] grants a stack of [Mediate].

name: Helish Aura
def: The party becomes immune to fire damage.

name: Thorns
def: Casting spells inflict [Poison] on a random enemy for 2 rounds.

name: Mending Spirit
def: Casting spells applies [Regeneration] to a random ally.

name: Foresight
def: See enemy actions before they perform them.

name: Timezone
def: Short rest is considered a long rest.

name: Blood Draw
def: Dealing magic damage will heal you.

name: Sacrifice
def: If you can_t spend mana to cast a spell, consume your health instaed.

name: Witchcraft
def: Gain advantage and proficiency in spellcrafting and witch arts.

name: Void Blessing
def: Grant summons, familiars, and constructs +1 Level.

name: Focus Point
def: Grant 50% crit chance to summons, familiars, and constructs.

name: Afterlife
def: Enemies dying will grant you +1 CON for the duration of the battle.

name: Second Passing
def: Gain -3 CON. On death, ressurect with 50% max health. Refreshes every battle.

name: Resurrection
def: The next ally that dies will be resurrected. Occurs once per battle.

name: Prayer
def: On turn skip, grant all party members [Defense] for 1 round.

name: Lucky
def: Grant yourself and your allies +1 on dice rolls.

name: Absolute
def: Upon dying, deal x2 [INT base] light damage on all enemies.

name: Spectrum
def: Critical hits on enemies will apply [Mirror] for 1 round.

name: Devotion
def: Gain WIS for the amount of enemies inflicted with [Stun].

name: Continuity
def: Reduce Magic base damage intake by half.

name: Magic Tinkerer
def: Gain advantage on Magic item crafting.

name: Tempest
def: Grant yourself and your allies +1 DEX.

name: Arrow Counter
def: Successful dodges from you or an ally grants fire Arrow Shot.

name: Quick Shot
def: [Stun] enemies automatically casts Open Fire on them at no cost.

name: Deck Buff
def: Randomly gain [Mana Card], [Flame Card], or [Heal Card].

name: Anxiety
def: [Fear], [Stun], and [Slow] triggers Dread on the target.

name: Jackpot
def: Ever 3 rounds, flip a coin to receive bonuses.

name: Puppet Show
def: Gain +1 CHA for each enemy inflicted with [Strung].

name: Show Time
def: Evert third ability used, enter [Stage Mode] for 3 rounds.

name: Background Track
def: Every round, cleanse a random ally of one debuff, infliction, or crowd control.

name: No Weapon
def: Gain +1 STR and +1 CON when weapon slot is empty.

name: Crew
def: Gain +1 STR for every living party member.

name: Holy Protection
def: Gain CON equal to half of base CHA.

name: Honor1
def: Gain CON equal to half of STR.

name: Clean
def: Gain immunity to inflictions and debuffs.

name: Calling
def: Gain CON equal to half of WIS.

name: Reply
def: Taking damage from enemies with [Passage] causes them to receive the same amount of damage.
